name: Ghosts of Loot
subtitle: shiny transcends death
rules: UNIQUE GHOSTS -- When this card blocks, your faction loses 2 influence and this card gains 4 life this turn. -- When this card attacks, your faction gains 1 influence and this card gains 2 strength this turn. -- [V][V] – When this card enters play, draw a card. -- [V][V][V][V][V] – When this card is destroyed, draw 4 cards. -- FLIP UP – 3 [G]

name: God's Blessing of Moola
subtitle: the living god enriches
rules: UNIQUE BLESSING -- ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains the following rules text: "When a character you control restores, it loses 1 strength this turn and you draw a card. -- Characters you control cannot be restored by your faction's RESTORE RULE. -- At the start of your turn, you may inflict 1 damage to your faction and restore a character you control. Repeat this once for each character you control."
notes: Image says 'once for each character you control'; catalog says 'once for every character'. Same meaning.

name: Gosche's Retained Earnings Vault
subtitle: hidden on goru-goru gidea for safekeeping
rules: When a character you control with a token on it leaves play, your faction gains 2 influence. -- INVEST -- COST – Deplete this card. Pay 2. Pick a character you control. -- EFFECT – Put a token on that character.

name: Great Mau General
subtitle: imperial army mercenary
rules: When this card inflicts damage, if your faction has 10 influence or less, your faction gains 2 influence.
flavor: A Mercenary Commander, conscripted under the Imperial Army due to his renown ferocity and expert tactics.

name: Haunting Execution
subtitle: hauntingly well executed
rules: EXTRA COST – If you have at least 4 characters in your discard pile, reduce this card's numeric cost by 3. Pick a character. -- Destroy the character. -- RECUR – [G] -- COST – Use this only if this card is in your discard pile. Pay 2. Remove this card from the game. Pick a character in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the character into your hand.

name: Key to the City
subtitle: luridia is safe... for now
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- When the attached character leaves play, you may search your deck for a resource, reveal it, and put it into your hand. -- UNLOCK POTENTIAL – [G] -- COST – Discard this card from your hand. Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a resource with a name you don't control, reveal it, and put it into your hand.
notes: Extra footer line bottom-left: 'Original Open R&D concept by Art Sams'.

name: Kitten Mittons
subtitle: is your mau making too much noise all the time!?
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- When the attached character is inflicted damage your faction gains that much influence.
flavor: Finally, there's an elegant comfortable mitton...for mau!
notes: Catalog: 'When damage is inflicted to the attached card, your faction gains influence equal to that damage.' Same effect, newer templating.

name: Limited Liability
rules: This turn, cards in play and cards deployed can only be destroyed by costs, and all inflicted damage is reduced to 0.
printing: EPOCH EDITION (vertical text along right edge); Ungodly Mess logo and The Spoils logo at bottom
notes: Full-art Epoch Edition layout, no collector number or copyright line.

name: Padamose Cultists
subtitle: worshipping the undead
rules: When this card enters play, if you have deployed a non-character card this turn, draw 2 cards.
flavor: Clockman is home to all manner of cults. It didn't take long before Padamose found himself at the center of one.

name: Pandering Politician
subtitle: redistributing wealth
rules: PANDER -- COST – Deplete this character. Pick a character or item. -- EFFECT – Remove a token from the picked card.
notes: Image says 'Deplete this character'; catalog says 'Deplete this card'. Same effect.

name: PP&E
subtitle: property plunder and exploitation
rules: PAY OFF -- COST – Use this only in response to a character being deployed. Deplete this card. Pay 1. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Terminate the character.

name: Pride of Goru-Goru Gidea
subtitle: destined to wander the oceans
rules: RESIST -- COST – Pay 1. Your faction loses 1 influence. -- EFFECT – Reduce the next damage inflicted to this card this turn by 1. -- DISAPPEAR -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains COVERT.
flavor: A cursed mirror of the Yenassa Shipping, LLP.

name: Regroup & Reassess
subtitle: "you're going to destroy the world!"
rules: Draw 2 cards. If you control an attacking party of at least 2 members, draw 2 more cards then discard a card. -- FLIP UP – 5 [G]
flavor: "Listen, I--" "You don't know--" "Stop talking over--" "I AM TOO PRETTY TO BE IGNORED!"
notes: Catalog has a comma after 'more cards'; trivial.

name: Smokin' Hottie
subtitle: got a light?
rules: When this card enters play, your faction loses 2 influence. -- [V][V][V][V] – This card gains COVERT.
notes: Catalog typo: '[V]V][V][V]' (missing bracket); card has four volition icons.

name: Strategic Vision
subtitle: we will steal gosche's gold!
rules: Search your deck for up to 2 different types of staple resources, not named "Greed", and reveal them. Put them into your hand. Your faction gains 1 influence.
flavor: And rule the waters from the Ironic Ocean to the Nidian Sea, free of the Countess at last!

name: Thabbashite Glutton
subtitle: unstoppable calories of doom
rules: [G][G][V][V] – When this card is destroyed, draw a card. When this card attacks, you may pick a card in a discard pile. If you do, remove it from the game. -- FLIP UP – 2 [V][V][V][V]

name: Unaccustomed Inspection
subtitle: staring into the god transport device isn't advised
rules: EXTRA COST – Pick a non-resource card. -- If the card has a [V] icon in its rules text, destroy the card. Otherwise, your faction loses influence equal to the card's numeric cost and flip the card face-down under its owner's control. -- FLIP UP – 2 [G][G]

name: Unfortunate Fortune Hunter
subtitle: left yenassa for adventure
flavor: "Arcanist Lords amassed untold wealth as a result of the commodification of voidal humour. Untrusting of the banker Mau class and unable to protect his treasure in person, Gosche hid witch clocks throughout Goru-Goru Gidea to protect his riches. Witch clocks, portable ritual casting devices, are considered dangerous, are usually illegal, and have proven highly effective."
notes: Text box holds only italic quoted flavor, no rules.

name: War Racketeer
subtitle: "i'll take forty-over-thirty on the Living God getting blowed up!"
rules: When this card enters play, draw a card for each character in play. -- UNDER THE TABLE -- COST – Discard 1 card. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card loses 1 life and gains 1 strength and COVERT.
notes: Image says 'this card loses 1 life'; catalog says 'this character loses 1 life'. Same effect.

name: Whistleblower Policy
subtitle: maybe we should think about this!
rules: EXTRA COST – You may pick a location. -- If you picked a location as part of this card's cost, add 3 damage markers to the location. If you deployed this card using FLIP UP, draw a card for each different staple resource you control. -- FLIP UP – 3 [G]
notes: Catalog says 'as a part of'; trivial.

name: Yenassa Shipping, LLP
subtitle: Limited Liability Pirates
rules: UNIQUE LLP -- This card gains 2 strength and 2 life for each item your opponents control. -- All items gain the rules text "At the start of your turn, you may pay 1. If you don't, destroy this card." -- FLIP UP – 1 [G][G][G]
flavor: But who sent them? Elizibeth's hired pirates would never tell of their queen.
notes: Subtitle printed with capitals: 'Limited Liability Pirates'. Flavor spelling 'Elizibeth' as printed. Catalog name typo: "Yenessa"; card prints "Yenassa".

name: Yenassa Shipping, LLP
subtitle: limited liability pirates
rules: UNIQUE LLP -- This card gains 2 strength and 2 life for each item your opponents control. -- All items gain the rules text "At the start of your turn, you may pay 1. If you don't, destroy this card." -- FLIP UP – 1 [G][G][G]
printing: SUPER RARE 2 of 6; full-art alternate layout; Ungodly Mess logo
notes: Footer reads 'SUPER RARE 2 of 6' (no collector number or copyright line). 'unique llp' printed in lowercase above the type line. Catalog name typo: "Yenessa"; card prints "Yenassa".

name: Acrolosian Outpost #30016968A
subtitle: good deal for you
rules: SNUB -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a card named Elitism and reveal it. Put it into your hand.
flavor: "We got your thingamajigs, your whoseawhatsits, your motronjuices, your dynamamites-- everything you need to watch the carnage and go home in style."

name: Animated Scrap Heap
subtitle: compiled from the remains of abandoned genius
rules: EXTRA COST – Choose a number for X. Pay X. -- This card enters play with X tokens on it. -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each token on it. -- EXPAND -- COST – Pay 3. -- EFFECT – Put a token on this card.

name: Beefy Researcher
subtitle: 6732 years young
rules: RESEARCH -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Reduce the next numeric cost you pay this turn by 1. -- [E][E][E][E][E][E] – This card gains 2 strength, 2 life and 2 speed.

name: Billowing Bouffant
subtitle: terror of the skies
rules: When this card enters play, you may destroy an item. -- FLIP UP – 6 [E]
flavor: Travel by air in Luridia is not advised.

name: Contriving Engineer
rules: When this card enters play, you may search your deck for a card named "Elitism" and reveal it. If you do, put it into play. Attach it to your faction.
printing: full-art alternate layout (stats printed as '2 STR 1 LIFE 3 SPD'); Ungodly Mess logo and The Spoils logo
notes: No collector number or copyright line.

name: Customized 31f
subtitle: imperial army abomination
rules: While there is a location or item in play, this card gains 2 strength and 2 life.
flavor: The Imperial Army is known to experiment on all manner of man and beast, erasing their memories and making them their pawns.

name: Direstock Cuffs
subtitle: see also: thabbashite slaves
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character loses COVERT. If the attached character has a [V] icon in its rules text, treat the attached character as though it has no rules text. -- MOVE -- COST – Pick a character that is not in battle. Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character. -- FLIP UP – 1 [E]
notes: Image says 'as though it has no rules text'; catalog says 'as though it had no rules text'. Grammar only.

name: Drainbow Crash
subtitle: nightclub VIP
rules: PROVIDES – [E][E] -- FLIP UP – 5 [E] and you may pick an item. If you do, destroy it.

name: Elite Acrolos Engineer
subtitle: screw the rules
rules: This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each different staple resource you control.

name: Ex Machina Majig
subtitle: we need machina power now!
rules: UNIQUE EX MACHINA -- When this card enters play, all your characters gain 1 strength and 1 life this turn. -- When this card leaves play, you may put up to five Micromajigs into play.

name: Fantastic Über Kool Creator Majig
subtitle: do you see it?
rules: UNIQUE CREATOR MAJIG -- EXTRA COST – Reduce this card's numeric cost by the number of [E] you control. -- At the start of your turn, you may play a resource. -- At the start of your turn, you may destroy a card you control that provides [E]. If you do, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand.

name: Fleet Majig
subtitle: monitoring the acrolosian exterior
rules: This card cannot be blocked. -- [E][E][E][E][E][E] – This card gains 2 strength and 2 life.
flavor: Acrolos is comprised of a chain of six islands on the border between the Specific Ocean and the Nidian Sea.

name: Frantic Jerryrigging
subtitle: god transporter: doubles as a blaster cannon
rules: EXTRA COST – Destroy an item you control. -- Search your deck for an item with numeric cost X+2 or less, reveal it, and put it into your hand or destroy an item your opponent controls with numeric cost X+2 or less.
flavor: Because you never know when a cannon will come in handy.
notes: Catalog adds the sentence 'X is its numeric cost.' to the EXTRA COST paragraph. The printed card never defines X (it just says 'Destroy an item you control.' then uses 'X+2'). Extra sentence in catalog could affect play, so flagged.

name: God's Blessing of Readiness
subtitle: the living god enlivens
rules: UNIQUE BLESSING -- ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains the following rules text: "All your characters lose 1 strength and gain 1 life. -- At the start of each opponent's turn, you may restore all characters you control."

name: Gosche's Solar Citadel
subtitle: life from the void
rules: When a non-token character you control with a token on it leaves play, you may put a micromajig token into play under you control. -- PROCESS -- COST – Deplete this card. Pay 2. Pick a character you control. -- EFFECT – Put a token on that character.
notes: Printed typo 'under you control'; catalog reads 'under your control'.

name: Jo Ciendeilio, Iron Born
typeLine: GEARSMITH CHARACTER – jo, blade of questionable morality
rules: UNIQUE JO -- Fealty – While this card is in your hand and you control at least 4 staple resources of different trades, reduce this card's threshold requirement by any 3 resource icons. -- When this card enters or leaves play, you may search your deck for a gearsmith item and reveal it. If you do, put it into your hand.
notes: 'Fealty' is printed in bold italic as a keyword label.

name: Last Minute Weaponization
subtitle: god transport cannon to the face
rules: EXTRA COST – Destroy an item you control. X was its numeric cost. Pick a character. -- Inflict X+1 damage to the character. You may search your deck for an item with numeric cost X or less, reveal it, and put it into your hand. -- FLIP UP – 2 [E][E][E][E]

name: Lead the Assault
subtitle: the horn thundered and the thabbashites came
rules: Pick an attacking character you control. It gains 2 strength and 2 life this turn. If you control an attacking party of at least 2 members, that character gains an additional 2 strength and 2 life this turn. -- FLIP UP – 4 [E]

name: Micromajig
printing: TOKEN 1 of 3; full-art token layout; Ungodly Mess logo
notes: Token: no cost printed (catalog says cost 0), no rules text, no copyright line. Art shows a majig with a red bow lounging on a couch.

name: Micromajig
printing: TOKEN 1 of 2; full-art token layout; Ungodly Mess logo
